messages.author: d698c1161cf874e6
messages.subject: winhr
parts:
Hi,

I am using g.shell.GGIR and trying to get a few different values for winhr (window size in hours for L5 and M5 analysis. I would like to get values for M5 L5 for 1 or 2 hours periods (M1, M2) as well as 5 hours. Ideally I want to know the peak 1 hour of exercise each day.

In the documentation provided for g.analyse it has winhr = 5 (which is the default). Later on under g.shell it show winhr = c(5,10). To me this suggests that it is possible to set multiple values for winhr.

However my experience is that it takes only the first (I think) value provided to make the calculation and provides only a single set of values, always named M5hr_ENMO etc.

Is there a way to get multiple values of peak ENMO for different time periods short of running g.analyse multiple times for each value? Alternatively I am new to GGIR so I might have made an error in there.

Thanks for all your help. It is a great package.
Tad

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] winhr
parts:
Hi Tad,
Winhr currently only works with one parameter setting. You will have to process your data twice with part2 to get the results for two settings I am afraid.
I have a part5 under development which does facilitate multiple winhr settings and hope to be able to add this to the functionality later this year.
Vincent
